2607.28110.title: BlueprintRepair: Typed Local Edits for Failed Lean Proof Blueprints
2607.28110.paper_summary: LLM-based Lean proving systems increasingly organize a proof as a blueprint: a dependency graph of formal statements. We introduce BlueprintRepair, a repair interface that lets a model change this graph through ten schema-checked local operations. An operation names the node it edits, so the target theorem cannot be changed. Lean checks every applied change, and an accepted repair must declare every blueprint lemma its proof uses. We also construct BlueprintTrace, a benchmark of 142 controlled failures with complete accepted and rejected repair trajectories. We compare typed edits, exact source patches, and complete module rewrites under matched source, feedback, model, and budget, one episode per state and interface. With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the three interfaces solve almost the same number of the benchmark's localized failures. Typed repair is the cheapest per solved state (patching is 1.30x as expensive, rewriting 2.06x), and within 10,000 completion tokens per task it reaches almost all of its final coverage, while both free-form interfaces are well behind. A second model, Qwen3.6-Flash, solves fewer states but keeps typed repair cheapest, puts it ahead on the proof-authoring states, and repeats the localized pattern.
2607.28110.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於 Lean 的證明系統越來越多地將證明組織為藍圖：一個形式語句的依賴圖。我們介紹了 BlueprintRepair，一個修復介面，允許模型通過十個經過模式檢查的局部操作來改變這個圖。一個操作命名它編輯的節點，因此目標定理無法被改變。Lean 檢查每一個應用的變更，接受的修復必須聲明其證明所使用的每個藍圖引理。我們還構建了 BlueprintTrace，一個包含 142 個控制失敗的基準，具有完整的接受和拒絕修復軌跡。我們在匹配的源、反饋、模型和預算下比較了類型編輯、精確源修補和完整模塊重寫，每個狀態和介面一個回合。使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，這三個介面幾乎解決了基準的相同數量的局部失敗。類型修復在每個解決狀態中是最便宜的（修補成本是 1.30 倍，重寫成本是 2.06 倍），並且在每個任務的 10,000 個完成標記內幾乎達到了其最終覆蓋率，而兩個自由形式的介面則落後很多。第二個模型 Qwen3.6-Flash 解決的狀態較少，但保持類型修復的最低成本，使其在證明創作狀態上領先，並重複了局部模式。
2607.28110.author: Ruslan Khrulev et.al.
